The double-star quotient has positive spectral determinant; exactly eight numerator-polynomial identities cover all off-diagonal entry classes and have 18,22,15,15,22,10,28,28 positive rational monomials. Exact coefficients and independent reconstruction are in certificate.json/verify.py; SPD gives positive diagonals.

value.rationale: An exact if-and-only-if topological positivity frontier for every finite unweighted tree, not a pointwise computation. The classification includes arbitrary large and arbitrarily unbalanced double stars via nontrivial high-degree coefficient identities, a natural stable numerical-diffusion family. It distinguishes graph-restricted unconditional positivity from the method-wide impossibility of positivity preservation on all Markov generators; it simultaneously characterizes all-step discrete maximum principles and max-norm contractivity.
